body_uses: [F1] [[def-qftx-smooth-sobolev-gauge-configuration]] fixes the Sobolev spaces and right-action convention. [[lem-qftx-gauge-sobolev-calculus]] gives the differential $D\Phi_A(0,0)(a,\xi)=a+d_A\xi$.

[F1] The spaces, finite-atlas norms, right-action formula, and irreducibility convention are those of the preceding definition; $H^k$ embeds continuously in $C^1$. [[def-qftx-smooth-sobolev-gauge-configuration]], [[lem-qftx-gauge-sobolev-calculus]]

[F6] The finite-atlas Sobolev product bounds hold in every integer order $0\le r\le k$: $\|fg\|_{H^r}\le C\|f\|_{H^k}\|g\|_{H^r}$. They follow by the product rule, the embeddings in [F1], and Hölder; when derivative orders are $b$ and $c$ with $b+c\le r$, the residual Sobolev orders $k-b$ and $r-c$ have sum at least $k>d/2$, so exponents can be chosen with reciprocal sum at most $1/2$. [[thm-higher-order-sobolev-embedding]], [[cor-sobolev-algebra-above-the-critical-index]], [[lem-qftx-gauge-sobolev-calculus]]

[F4] For every stated sphere bundle, $\mathcal A_\infty^*$ is nonempty and path connected, and $\pi_j(\mathcal A_\infty^*,A)=0$ for every irreducible $A$ and $j\ge1$. [[thm-qftx-irreducible-connections-weak-contractibility]]

[F5] For every $N\ge2$ and every bundle on $S^3$, the reduced smooth gauge group has infinitely many path components; for every bundle on $S^4$, its fundamental group at the identity is nontrivial. [[thm-qftx-reduced-gauge-group-sphere-nontriviality]]

[F1] The Sobolev connection space is affine, the right gauge action is smooth, and its derivative at $(A,e)$ is $(a,\xi)\mapsto a+d_A\xi$. [[def-qftx-smooth-sobolev-gauge-configuration]], [[lem-qftx-gauge-sobolev-calculus]]
[F2] The reduced action is free and proper, and the irreducible locus is open. [[lem-qftx-gauge-stabilizer-and-properness]]
[F3] The Coulomb splitting is $H^k(T^*M\otimes\operatorname{ad}P)=\ker d_A^*\oplus\operatorname{im}d_A$, with bounded projection $d_AG_Ad_A^*$. [[lem-qftx-covariant-laplacian-sobolev-splitting]]
